programme.title: Max Havoc: Curse of the Dragon
programme.desc: Exotic action/adventure and martial arts blend together as Max Havoc, world famous kickboxer turned sports photographer, faces the relentless Black Dragons in a reluctant quest to save the lovely Goody sisters and to avenge the death of good friend Tahsi in Guam.

programme.title: 12 Hours to Live
programme.desc: 18 year old Amy is kidnapped by a deranged gunman wanted for the murder of an FBI Agent and FBI Agent Megan is hot on his trail. When it's learned that Amy is a type-1 diabetic, Megan must once again confront the man who violently killed her partner to save Amy.

programme.title: Last Chance Cafe
programme.desc: After uncovering evidence that her stepfather was murdered by a ring of corrupt cops and judges, including her DA ex-husband, a woman is forced to flee with her daughter and hide in a small farming town, where she falls for a local ranch owner but danger soon follows.

programme.title: San Saba
programme.desc: Private Investigator Bud wakes from a coma in a hospital room and is immediately charged with murder but did he do it or was he framed? As the story unfolds in flashback, Bud discovers that no one seems to be who he or she claim to be and everyone's motives are suspect.

programme.title: Universal Soldier II: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: Luc and Veronica recover and revive Luc's long-lost brother who has been suspended in a cryo-chamber for decades and attempt to expose the Unisol program, led by Mazur (Gary Busey), which recycles dead soldiers in the attempt to create the ultimate mercenary army.

programme.title: Max Havoc: Ring of Fire
programme.desc: Max Havoc is on a new assignment staying at a luxury hotel in the heart of a big city only to discover that the classy hotel owner is a vicious mob boss heading up a crime ring full of unwanted teenagers in the nearby slums.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.desc: Strange happenings occur to some friends before a birthday party in a large warehouse. Two of them find an old spirit board and they decide to contact the dead victim former tenants...

programme.title: Dead End Demon (aka Dead End 2)
programme.desc: It has been almost 2 years since the small town of Santa Carla had suffered in the hands of the raging maniac, Cameron Crowe. Legend around town had it as that he may have been burnt in a fire he started...

programme.title: Dinosaur Hotel 2
programme.desc: Surviving contestants are reunited in the ultimate game to win 10 million dollars. Only one contestant will survive and claim the prize as the others fall to the dinosaurs...

programme.title: The Leprechaun's Game
programme.desc: After a bunch of thieves are sent out to hunt for urban legends by a wealthy man intending to open a museum full of mythical creatures. Soon, the thieves will learn the legend of a Leprechaun...

programme.title: The Body Tree
programme.desc: When a group of Americans travels to Russian Siberia to honor the memory of their murdered friend, they uncover a plot that threatens all their lives...

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: A supernatural stalker pursues a super model to steal her soul with his demonic camera...

programme.title: The Mermaid's Curse
programme.desc: A young man falls in love with a seductive, sultry, young woman he meets on the beach. The more he falls for her, the more he will learn the dangers of falling in love with a siren...

programme.title: American Beast (aka Beast of Prey)
programme.desc: After finding an old storage locker filled with his family's history, James Erikson begins a journey to discover the truth behind a mysterious piece of land in the small town of Solitude...

programme.title: Die In One Day
programme.desc: After a failed marriage, Richard is in search of his daughter Mindy. He meets Sasha, an aspiring actress who promises to help him. But the hope to get some quick cash by performing in a 24 hours play soon turns out to be a bloody game...

programme.title: The Midnight Man
programme.desc: Hoping to fix their dysfunctional marriage, a couple travels to an isolated mountain cabin to work out their problems - but the one problem they didn't anticipate is the maniac trying to kill them...

programme.title: Alp
programme.desc: After a traumatic experience, Chris comes home to confront his past. but soon finds himself prey to a Demon who taunts him through sleep paralysis...

programme.title: Camp Massacre
programme.desc: Ten obese men appear on a competitive reality show geared toward weight-loss. As contestants disappear in the night it becomes apparent that a killer is on the loose...

programme.title: Creature in the Dark
programme.desc: After strange creatures arrive, a husband waiting for the return of his wife, must adjust to being sole caretaker of his young daughter, while dealing with what is in his basement...

programme.title: Baby Doll
programme.desc: A group of student in vacation find themselves in a house where strange rituals were performed. The sudden finding of a doll bring the group on a downward spiral...

programme.title: Blue Hour
programme.desc: Olivia Brandreth was nine years old when her father disappeared. Twenty five years later, she has returned to her childhood home to finally get closure in an unrelenting attempt to set the record straight...

programme.title: El Demonio Interior
programme.desc: Años después de salir de la cárcel, Sam Parsons intenta rehacer su vida con su mujer Courtney y su hija Harper. Trabaja duro para mantener a su familia y permitirse una bonita casa en su tranquilo barrio de las afueras. Cuando empiezan a ocurrir sucesos sobrenaturales en la casa, Sam teme por la seguridad de su mujer y su hija. Cuando los sucesos se convierten en ataques, Sam contrata a Corbin Carlysle y a su equipo de cazafantasmas conocido como «The Ghost Killers», para que le ayuden a luchar contra la entidad oscura que acecha en las sombras de su casa. Cuando las cosas empiezan a complicarse y queda claro que esta entidad es mucho más peligrosa que el típico fantasma, surgen complicaciones cuando Corbin y su equipo se centran más en la fama y la fortuna. Para ganar esta lucha Sam debe luchar contra sus propios demonios interiores y volver a su violento pasado. Para salvar a sus seres queridos, un Demonio debe enfrentarse a un Demonio.

programme.title: Portal de Monstruos de H.P. Lovecraft
programme.desc: Una secta está a punto de despertar a la criatura más temida de H.P. Lovecraft...

programme.title: Jack y Jill
programme.desc: Una adaptación terrorífica de la canción infantil Jack y Jill. Un grupo de amigos afligidos por una pérdida reciente se reúnen sólo para descubrir que están siendo perseguidos por Jack y Jill...

programme.title: Krampus 2: El Diablo Regresa
programme.desc: Cinco años después del asesinato de su esposa y la desaparición de su hija, el ex policía Jeremy Duffin es traído de vuelta para ayudar en la caza de un monstruo de Yuletide que castiga a los niños que han sido «traviesos». A medida que el monstruo se vuelve más errático e impredecible, Jeremy descubre la verdad sobre la desaparición de su hija y el destino que le ha deparado una fuente improbable. ¿Podrá Jeremy acabar finalmente con la pesadilla del monstruo navideño que ha aterrorizado a este pueblo durante años?

programme.title: Contención
programme.desc: ¿Qué ocurre cuando estalla una epidemia y no se sabe nada? Puede ocurrir cualquier cosa. Poco a poco, los residentes se dan cuenta de que todos morirán a menos que se unan...

programme.title: Poltergeist Americano
programme.desc: Horribles visiones atormentan a Taryn cuando ella, su hermano y sus compañeros de universidad se mudan a una vieja e infame casa. Entonces, sus sangrientas alucinaciones se vuelven demasiado reales...

programme.title: Isla de las Muñecas
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas va a la legendaria Isla de las Muñecas para conocer la verdad mortal...

programme.title: El Mal Interior
programme.desc: Un chico solitario y mentalmente discapacitado se hace amigo de su reflejo en un espejo antiguo. Esta criatura demoníaca le ordena que se lance a una matanza asesina de las personas que más quiere...

programme.title: Ana
programme.desc: Dos hombres roban una muñeca de un museo que, sin saberlo, abre una puerta al Infierno...

programme.title: Alfredo
programme.desc: Brendan Cobbs, un famoso novelista, es enviado a una remota cabaña de la Inglaterra rural en busca de inspiración para su próxima novela. Cree haber encontrado su próximo tema cuando se encuentra con Alfred, un muñeco del tamaño de un niño que puede cobrar vida. Pero surgen consecuencias mortales cuando Brendan se da cuenta de que Alfred tiene intención de matar.

programme.title: Hotel Dinosaurio
programme.desc: Sienna está desesperada por ganar un gran premio en metálico en un concurso secreto clandestino, pero los dinosaurios comienzan a cazarla para entretenimiento de los ricos y adinerados. ¿Podrá ser la última en sobrevivir a la horrible noche para ganar el premio?

programme.title: Kecksburg
programme.desc: Un reportero investiga un misterioso accidente y descubre algo más que un objeto, sino una enorme conspiración gubernamental. Inspirada en los hechos reales del 9 de diciembre de 1965 y en uno de los incidentes OVNI más misteriosos de Estados Unidos...

programme.title: El Culto de Humpty Dumpty
programme.desc: Un grupo de adolescentes con problemas y su maestra deben luchar por sobrevivir después de descubrir que una secta ha devuelto la vida a Humpty Dumpty, un muñeco asesino, y lo ha liberado en el campamento en el que se encuentran...

programme.title: El Bosque del Diablo
programme.desc: Rachel y su equipo de cineastas viajan a Transilvania, Rumania, para documentar los fenómenos paranormales en el bosque de Hoia-Baciu...

programme.title: Mi Sangriento Cumpleaños
programme.desc: Tras un terrible trauma en su cumpleaños, Emma decide no volver a celebrarlo. Pero al cumplir 21, una amiga rompe el ritual con una fiesta sorpresa, sin percatarse del despertar de los horrores que durante años han estado acechando en la oscuridad...

programme.title: La Feria del Diablo
programme.desc: Protagonizada por Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson y John Charles Dickson. Las estrellas de dos series de televisión paranormales, rivales y enfrentadas, convergen en un parque de atracciones embrujado y abandonado que termina siendo el epicentro del infierno. Ahora están todos atrapados en una guerra sin cuartel contra el mal puro...

programme.title: Naufragio
programme.desc: Mientras transportaba un paquete importante, una joven sufre un accidente de coche en medio de la nada, dejándola atrapada debajo del coche. Poco a poco, se da cuenta de que no solo unos hombres muy malvados la persiguen para recuperar el objeto que transporta, sino que algo muy peligroso la acecha desde las profundidades del bosque...

programme.title: El Juego del Duende
programme.desc: Después de que un hombre adinerado envía a un grupo de ladrones a buscar leyendas urbanas con la intención de abrir un museo lleno de criaturas míticas, pronto descubrirán la leyenda de un duende...

programme.title: Verano Sangriento
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes llegan a Mallorca para disfrutar de unas idílicas vacaciones de verano, pero adentrándose en los lugares más inhóspitos de la isla comenzarán un viaje infernal...

programme.title: Juicios de Brujas
programme.desc: Dos realizadores de documentales y un ex policía investigan la desaparición de una niña que se rumorea que fue secuestrada por una bruja en los bosques encantados de Connecticut...

programme.title: Habitación Ouija
programme.desc: Una mujer agorafóbica con autismo comienza a invocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano/cuidador está ausente durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo...

programme.title: Serpiente
programme.desc: El equipo de construcción desarrolló a ciegas la isla desconocida, lo que alertó a las dos feroces criaturas de la isla para que fueran destruidas...

programme.title: Recuérdame
programme.desc: Rose despierta en una casa desconocida tras un grave accidente de coche, con pérdida de memoria y sin poder caminar. Su madre y su novio están allí para ayudarla. Rose quiere reconstruir su vida antes del accidente. No todo es lo que parece...

programme.title: La Maldición de la Sirena
programme.desc: Un joven se enamora de una joven seductora y sensual que conoce en la playa. Cuanto más se enamora de ella, más aprende los peligros de enamorarse de una sirena...

programme.title: Aldea del Vampiro
programme.desc: Rebecca busca a su hermana, una joven periodista desaparecida mientras investigaba una serie de desafortunados sucesos. El rastro la conduce a Timere, un lugar remoto alejado del ajetreo de la vida cotidiana, donde entre el hermético silencio de los habitantes del pueblo crece el temor a que actúen fuerzas oscuras y nadie se atreve a salir de casa por la noche. Aquí Rebecca conoce a un extravagante escritor, al guardián de la iglesia del pueblo y, sobre todo, a Caleb, un hombre encantador, rico y elegante cuya oscura mirada esconde un escalofriante secreto. Es en este pueblo, donde el tiempo parece moverse entre las sombras y el peligro acecha en cada esquina, donde Rebecca se entera de la terrible verdad y comienza la batalla entre el bien y el mal...

programme.title: Día del Abandono
programme.desc: Jenny Bilson, una estudiante de último curso de instituto, es la estudiante perfecta, la maravillosa hija de un veterano detective de policía y todo un sueño americano. Pero el único error que no es consciente de haber cometido está a punto de perseguirla de una forma muy violenta, cuando su pasado regresa en busca de venganza...

programme.title: Isla Pitón
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas que buscan un árbol mágico en una selva misteriosa descubren que no están solos. Algo los observa, esperando el momento perfecto para atacar...

programme.title: Jack y Jill: Las Colinas del Infierno
programme.desc: Tras buscar a su hija desaparecida, una dama y su grupo de búsqueda descubren la leyenda que se esconde tras la pareja asesina de Jack y Jill...

programme.title: Ouija: Reunión Mortal
programme.desc: Sucesos extraños les ocurren a unos amigos antes de una fiesta de cumpleaños en un gran almacén. Dos de ellos encuentran un viejo tablero de espiritismo y deciden contactar con los antiguos inquilinos de la víctima fallecida...

programme.title: En Un Lugar De La Mancha
programme.desc: En una pequeña localidad de La Mancha, Isabel y Silvia, cansadas de esconder su pasión, deciden marcharse un fin de semana a la casa rural que alquila el sacerdote de un pueblo cercano. Pronto lamentarán su decisión.

programme.title: El Expediente Belchite
programme.desc: El expediente Belchite no es solamente una historia de miedo; como toda narración que nos habla de una trascendencia más allá de vida terrena, la película plantea interrogantes sobre la finitud, o no, de eso que algunos llaman alma.

programme.title: Después Del Azul
programme.desc: Fausto se electrocuta y queda en coma, sobrevive con la realidad alterada, escucha a la soledad y ve varias mujeres que le representan la muerte.

programme.title: La Llaman Cazadora de Cabezas
programme.desc: Después de escapar de un refugio para personas sin hogar infestado de carnívoros zombis, ambos policías descubren que el mundo entero ahora está sumido en el caos.

programme.title: Lucero
programme.desc: Claustrofóbica, demente y puntualmente burlona, “Lucero” no sólo es una perla del fantástico de trinchera sino la enésima prueba de la capacidad de su director para, sin apenas medios y desde los márgenes de una industria fílmica como la española actual rendida al gusto indiferenciado y a la mentalidad de cadena de montaje, generar obras sugestivas, disconformes y estridentes en el mejor sentido.

programme.title: Toda La Noche
programme.desc: Una pareja argentina en una fiesta en el campo se encuentra con que están matando a sus amigos.

programme.title: La Otra Palabra
programme.desc: Película documental que se adentra a lo más profundo de las prácticas esotéricas más antiguas. ¿Qué es la magia? ¿Es jugar con el diablo?

programme.title: Morirse En Domingo
programme.desc: Julio Salas muere tras una larga enfermedad, pero es domingo y su familia por dificultades económicas se ve forzada a contratar los servicios de una modesta agencia funeraria.

programme.title: El Secreto Oculto
programme.desc: Describe los eventos del fin de los tiempos de la humanidad profetizada por místicos y Santos sobre los 3 días de oscuridad en que los demonios serán soldados ...

programme.title: The Juniors y La Formula Imperial
programme.desc: Narra las vidas de 7 adolescentes millonarios que se aventuran a planificar una revolución social, generada por vídeo-escándalos y experimentos médicos, con el objetivo de generar un cambio en la ideología mundial, el conflicto entre las clases sociales y el enfrentamiento con sus muchachas de servicio doméstico.

programme.title: Hienas
programme.desc: Luis ha metido la pata... hasta el fondo. Pero Pepe está ahí para ayudarlo... a caer. Ninguno de los dos tenía idea del grandísimo lío en el que andaban metidos ya desde hacía tiempo. Una liada de cojones.

programme.title: Reto Sangriento
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes investigadores de fenómenos paranormales reciben el reto de pasar un fin de semana en una casa donde habitan seres malignos. programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Nashville
programme.desc: We take a behind the scenes look at Nashville, TN and discover that music really does feed the soul. Featuring interviews with Vince Gill & The Time Jumpers, the Loveless Cafe, and the Bluebird Cafe.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Philadelphia
programme.desc: We explore Philadelphia, otherwise known as the City of Brotherly Love. From learning how it all began with our founding fathers at the Constitution Center to experiencing the original Philly Cheesesteak at the place that created it, we explore and live like a lcoal in Philly.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Huntsville
programme.desc: We discover why they call it Home Sweet Alabama with an inside peak in Huntsville! Featuring a behind the scenes look at the US Space & Rocket Center then we discover the haunted spots of downtown with a mysterious ghost walk, then ending the day with some famous Pecan Pie.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Katonah
programme.desc: We explore Katonah, NY starting out the day with fresh farm & country at the Harvest Moon Orchard all while enjoying a local car show. We discover the history of Katonah from those who know it best and end our day with beautiful music at Caramoor.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Bowling Green
programme.desc: We learn why Bowling Green is the corvette capital with a behind the scenes look at the world famous corvette museum! From there we zoom our way with corvette test drive on the race track and then head to some caves to explore the unknown. We end our day with some fresh made ice cream at Chaney's Dairy Barn.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Outer Banks
programme.desc: We explore the Outer Banks. Starting the day out at the beach discovering wild horses. From there we go to the National Wright Brothers Monument where the first fliights took place. We top off our day visiting some historic lighthouse and some local cuisine.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Franklin
programme.desc: We discover Franklin, TN also known to its locals for being voted as best small town in TN. Adventure starts our day, with a thrilling and beautiful ride showcasing the town views in a hot air balloon ride. From there we explore the history of downtown Franklin and end the day with some amazing southern cuisine.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Hoboken
programme.desc: We explore Hoboken and learn all about the charm of this famous neighborhood. Starting out the day with the "Mozzeralla Boss" we learn how to make mozzeralla from the king himself. From there we learn more about the history of Hoboken and its famous residents including the late Frank Sinatra. We end our day with art and fresh made delicacys.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: The Hamptons
programme.desc: We live like a local in The Hamptons. From paddle boarding the morning away to learning about art and history from the local experts we see everything the Hamptons has to offer. We top off the day with a classic float from the locals favorite spot.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: West Village
programme.desc: We explore the West Village in NYC, known to most as one of the most iconic neighborhoods in Manhattan. From sea salt cookies to handmade toys and collectibles we get to know the neighborhood first hand through its innovative locals and shops.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Annapolis
programme.desc: We enjoy a day to kayaking in this beautiful naval neighborhood. We learn first hand from local historians the rich history of Annapolis and of adventure in Annapolis. Starting out the day with some great eat from the famous Chick n' Ruths top off the day at the annual Crab Fest!

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Broadway
programme.desc: Lights, Camera, Broadway! We explore the VIP spots of Broadway and learn about how it all started. From a behind the scenes look at the famous Sardis to topping off the day at one of the citys most iconic cabaret spots!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters: Concord, MA
programme.desc: This historic town northwest of Boston played a significant role in the American Revolutionary War. Come along as Nick explores the Minuteman National Historical Park, visits the Concord Museum, and takes a stroll through Authors Ridge, the resting place of famous authors such as Henry David Thoreau and Ralph Waldo Emerson. Discover the rich history of this charming New England town.

programme.title: Going Beyond S01E12
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Mohawk Bison Farm and Black Hog Brewery
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Plum and the team are joined by Chef Adam Bedini as they head out to the countryside to visit Peter Fay and Mohawk Bison in Goshen, CT. Tour the farm with Plum and try out a unique summer grilling recipe! and Chef Plum takes Edible Nutmeg on the road to Oxford, CT to speak with the guys who make Black Hog Brewery's exceptional beer and learn a unique recipe for garlicky, gingery, beer-infused clams!

programme.title: Authentic Escapes: Austria
programme.desc: In this episode, Sandra McLemore invites you to experience Austria like never before—through its royal palaces, charming villages, and centuries-old traditions. Wander through Schönbrunn Palace after hours, uncovering secret passageways, regal ballrooms, and stories of Empress Sisi. Then, watch a master pastry chef craft the perfect apple strudel—Vienna’s most iconic dessert. The journey continues to Dürnstein, a fairytale village in the Wachau Valley, where apricot orchards, wine, and UNESCO charm steal the spotlight. And in Hallstatt, go underground for an epic adventure through the world’s oldest working salt mine—slides, miner’s gear, and all. Along the way, Sandra shares must-know travel tips for making the most of your Austrian escape. From imperial elegance to alpine thrills, this episode blends history, culture, and flavor into one unforgettable journey.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes: Istanbul
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart of Istanbul—a city where East meets West, and ancient tradition blends seamlessly with modern life. From the vibrant Spice Bazaar filled with Turkish delight and tea, to Michelin-starred Ottoman cuisine that revives centuries-old royal recipes, Sandra dives deep into the flavors and culture of this mesmerizing destination. She explores the mysterious Basilica Cistern, a hidden underground marvel, and reveals the artistry behind handwoven Turkish carpets—each a story told in knots and color. With practical travel tips, immersive storytelling, and a few laughs along the way, this episode is both a guide and a love letter to one of the world’s most captivating cities. Whether you're drawn to history, food, shopping, or simply want to experience something magical, Istanbul delivers—and this episode shows you why it belongs on every traveler’s bucket list.

programme.title: How To Build Generational Wealth Starting with Your Children
programme.desc: Hey everyone! Today we're diving into an eye-opening conversation with Holly Reid, CEO of The Master Playbook. Holly's on a mission to help families and business owners build lasting wealth and leave a powerful legacy. In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, key takeaways from our chat included: 1. Legacy building isn't just for the ultra-rich. It's about creating value that lasts beyond your lifetime. 2. Forget complex financial jargon - Holly focuses on mindset shifts to kickstart your wealth journey. 3. Resistance from family members? Holly offers tips to address concerns and highlight the positive impact of increased wealth. 4. We discuss the importance of preparing your business for unexpected events. Holly shared a personal story that really drives this point home. 5. Action steps you can take today: Adopt a "legacy builder mentality," invest in yourself and your community, and start documenting your business assets properly. Holly's company, The Master Playbook, is all about empowering the next generation to master money. Whether you're a parent or a business owner, her insights can help you create a lasting financial impact. Remember, as Holly says, "Legacy isn't built on intention alone. You have to take intentional action." So let's get out there and start building our financial legacies!

programme.desc: Dr. Yolanda Whitaker, the legendary Grammy-nominated rapper, actress, and philanthropist best known as Yo-Yo, opens up about her new cooking show on aspireTV, the 50th anniversary of hip hop, and her advice for young female rappers.

programme.title: Lynae Vanee Talks Power, Purpose, and 'The People’s Brief'
programme.desc: Multi-hyphenate creator, poet, and cultural commentator Lynae Vanee steps into the spotlight as the host of "The People’s Brief," REVOLT’s raw and unapologetic news commentary series. In this exclusive Black Enterprise interview with Selena Hill, the three-time NAACP Image Award nominee shares her journey from high school teacher to digital powerhouse, and unpacks her vision for truth-telling, creative freedom, and the future of Black America.

programme.title: From Intern to President: Shari Bryant Shares Her Journey at Roc Nation
programme.desc: Shari Bryant, the co-president of Jay-Z’s Roc Nation, opens up about the challenges she's faced and lessons she's learned while climbing the ladder to become a music business executive.

programme.title: Fireside Chat Leading America's Financial Freedom Movement
programme.desc: Operation HOPE CEO John Hope Bryant joins BLACK ENTERPRISE CEO Earl “Butch” Graves Jr. to discuss financial inclusion, economic empowerment, and wealth creation as the civil rights issues of our time.

programme.title: Town Hall Luncheon
programme.desc: Join Ed Gordon and 2025 XCEL Award honorees for an open forum on leadership, accountability, and taking action to create meaningful change beyond the Summit.

programme.title: From Operations to Leadership
programme.desc: Learn to understand and analyze Profit & Loss statements, grasp key financial concepts, and confidently discuss financial performance to improve business decision-making.

programme.title: Ayesha Curry & Sydel Curry-Lee Talk Luxury Wine
programme.desc: Ayesha Curry and Sydel Curry-Lee open up about the launch of their wine company, Domaine Curry, and its acquisition by Prisoner Wine Company. The famous sisters-in-law also talked about Black women's impact on the wine industry and their newly released 2023 Sauvignon Blanc.

programme.title: Building an Empire
programme.desc: Chef Helene Henderson started by teaching cooking classes and hosting dinners at home. She now has multiple Malibu Farm restaurant locations across California, Hawaii, New York, and Japan.

programme.title: Supporting the Creator Economy
programme.desc: Kesi Gibson founded Club Debut to provide the infrastructure and technology that helps creative entrepreneurs run successful businesses

programme.title: Diversifying Fashion for the Next Generation
programme.desc: Shaw Bernard, founder of Black-owned, woman-owned agency STRUT Models, is building a more inclusive industry one model at a time

programme.title: Navigating Corporate Success With Jeannine K Brown
programme.desc: Getting hired in a new job can be an exciting step forward for those carving out career paths. At the same time, the journey to success can be elusive. Navigating the ins and outs of the corporate world and trying to get ahead isn’t always easy when you’re unsure how to get promoted and move up the corporate ladder. Jeannine K. Brown, founder of Everyday Lead and author of Unstuck and Unstoppable, understands the complexities of getting ahead in a corporate role. In this episode, Brown discussed ways to learn the art of self-promotion. Beyond addressing the challenges in larger corporate settings, Brown's principles are relevant for small businesses aiming to foster a culture of success.

programme.title: Fat Joe Promises to Amplify The Culture With His New Talk Show
programme.desc: Fat Joe takes us inside his new weekly talk show hosted and executive-produced by the Grammy-nominated artist and cultural icon. The show sees the hip-hop superstar bring the audience along for intimate conversations and recall unheard stories with some of America's biggest names. Fat Joe will drive the discussion in ways that only he can.

programme.title: Should You Be Open Minded? Does it Hurt or Help
programme.desc: In this episode of the Rundown with Ramon, small business expert, Ramon Ray talks about the power of being open minded. Open minded does not mean we have to AGREE with the person but it means we're open to their ideas. Check out the full episode for this topic and others featured on The Rundown with Ramon

programme.title: Jay Jordan of Reform Alliance Explains Importance of Probation Reform
programme.desc: Jay Jordan, Reform Alliance’s new VP of Community Engagement, is shedding light on the nonprofit’s new C-Suite additions and the critical role they’ll play in driving its mission forward. He breaks down why Reform’s focus on probation and parole reform is so essential to criminal justice reform—and how having major celebrity support helps bring both attention and bipartisan momentum to the cause.

programme.title: XCEL Awards Night 2025
programme.desc: The XCEL Summit Awards celebrate outstanding leaders whose achievements and impact inspire future generations, especially men of color. Hosted by Emmy Award-winning journalist Ed Gordon.

programme.title: Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor and "Nickel Boys" Cast Dig Deep In Historical Drama
programme.desc: Director RaMell Ross, actors Ethan Herisse, Brandon Wilson, Daveed Diggs, and actress Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor take us inside the captivating new historical drama "The Nickel Boys."

programme.title: Finding Career Freedom
programme.desc: Juliet Hall, author of “Own Your Opportunities,” shares how you can start your own journey of professional self-discovery and self-determination

programme.title: Supermodel & Founder Winnie Harlow Talks New Suncare Line Cay Skin
programme.desc: The top model-turned-entrepreneur opens up about launching a "sun care" skin line, raising $6.5 million for her beauty brand, and more.

programme.title: Jay Jordan of Reform Alliance Explains Importance of Probation Reform
programme.desc: Jay Jordan, Reform Alliance’s new VP of Community Engagement, is shedding light on the nonprofit’s new C-Suite additions and the critical role they’ll play in driving its mission forward. He breaks down why Reform’s focus on probation and parole reform is so essential to criminal justice reform—and how having major celebrity support helps bring both attention and bipartisan momentum to the cause.

programme.title: Episode 5: THE EXERT-A-TRON
programme.desc: Maya invents the Exert-A-Tron, an exercising machine that promises all the benefits of exercise without actually expending any effort. The Exert-A-Tron misses a fundamental point: exercise is fun!

programme.title: Episode 6: DAZZLE LAND ART DAY
programme.desc: DazzleLand Art Day is the perfect chance for Bommi and her friends to discover that everyone is an artist and we can all create beautiful things.

programme.title: Episode 7: BORIS' BIRTHDAY
programme.desc: After a delicious Razzle Dazzle Birthday Frazzle, it's time for Boris's birthday gifts. But it turns out that his Dazzle Land gifts are better suited for the givers than Boris

programme.title: Episode 8: RAINBOW-ZZLES AND DAZZLE
programme.desc: When Yip doesn't share his skateboard with Taco, and Remba doesn't share her secret Rainbow-zzle recipe with Maya, the friendships in Dazzle Land begin to frazzle.

programme.title: Episode 9: TRY TRY AGAIN
programme.desc: Remba believes that she can learn to the play borzzlehorn just by listening to it. Yip believes that he can learn to jump rope just by watching Taco.

programme.title: Episode 10: A LITTLE HELP FROM MY FRIENDS
programme.desc: A magical dazzle kite draws pictures in the sky, alerting Bommi and friends to others in need. In a fun sequence of adventures, everyone realizes how friendships are made stronger

programme.title: Episode 11: A TAILING TALE
programme.desc: Razzle Dazzle Day celebrates the uniqueness of Dazzle Land with a Surprise Dazzle. But it only happens if all the friends are together at sunset ...

programme.title: Episode 12: THE BIG CLEAN
programme.desc: Unusual Clean-up Weather is heading the way of Bommi and Friends! After the falling soap bubbles, the rain and the drying wind machines, it's time to put everything away

programme.title: Episode 13: THE GREAT RACE
programme.desc: It's the great Fazzmobile Relay Race and Maya has promised Yip that he can drive one of the Fazzmobiles. However, she reconsiders and decides to drive it herself, breaking her promise to Yip.

programme.title: To Cut
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring story of Stuart Linder, a prominent American plasticsurgeon. Once deterred by his teachers from pursuing medical practices, now one of the most sough after professionals in practice.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Unable to come to terms with the death of his brother by the hands of a police officer, Quincy is pushed to face his emotions and navigate his new reality. In doing so, he is presented with an opportunity to seek justice in an unconventional way.

programme.title: Xavier
programme.desc: A biographical documentary short that tells the story of a chance meeting of social media peronality Blake Linder and cancer warrior Xavier Mejias. This visual challenges audiences to reach for higher levels of compassion, selflessness, mentorship and gratefulness while begging the question "are you truly connecting with people on social media".

programme.title: All My Friends Are Robots
programme.desc: After one brother clicks a strange hyperlink, two siblings must battle their best friend—now transformed into a relentless humanoid—before the glitch consumes them all.

programme.title: Ashes To Ashes
programme.desc: When Xavier unexpectedly receives the ashes of his dead father in the mail, he is forced to confront a lifetime of daddy issues.

programme.title: Below Watson's
programme.desc: Beneath the charm of Watson’s Soda Fountain and Café on East Chapman Avenue in Orange, California, lies a mystery sealed in brick and shadow. Once a bustling drug store and diner during the Prohibition era, the café is said to sit above a hidden network of tunnels that have long been blocked from public view. Were these tunnels a lifeline, a smuggling route—or something far more dangerous? This documentary highlights the community that whispers about the layers of history, chasing the echoes of footsteps that may never have wanted to be found.

programme.title: Candles
programme.desc: In this short psychological thriller, a seemingly grieveing and sinister teen boy. Is his therapist an emotional anchor? Or is she someone quite sinister herself?

programme.title: Chick Bait
programme.desc: In this lighthearted comedy, a lonely, overweight man just wants to enjoy a quiet afternoon and his baskin robbins Ice cream. But his simple pleasure takes a wild turn when a mischievous dachshund waddles up, steals his sweet trea. the man tries to shoo the dog away, but fate has other plans. A charming young woman notices the adorable thief and mistakes the man for its doting owner. Suddenly thrust into an unexpected role, he finds himself sharing laughs and lunch with her, daydreaming that maybe, just maybe, this accident could lead to love. But just as the sparks begin to flicker, disaster strikes. The real owner appears, frantic and furious at finding the “lost” dog in the man’s company. A story of ice cream, mistaken identity, and a very determined little dog.

programme.title: Dream To Sell
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring rags to riches story of Simon Sarradine, a prominent American with lebanese ancestry. Once a struggling boy, now the king of a motor-vehicle empire, who continues to dream bigger.

programme.title: Father Figure
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps his two children, consumed by resentment toward his ex-wife, Diana, and convinced that only he can provide them a safe home. But as his desperation grows, Richard's obsessive need for control begins to expose the monstrous reflection of his own flaws. Meanwhile, their fractured family becomes the target of the Father Figure-a sinister entity that preys on children from broken, unstable homes. When the demon abducts the children, Richard is forced to face the consequences of his destructive choices and the darker truths about himself. Now, he must confront the ultimate evil to save his children, before his mistakes doom him forever.

programme.desc: A young man's battle with the influence of alcohol

programme.title: Jelly
programme.desc: A unsuspecting couple stumble into a doughnut shop looking for relief and refreshments but end up getting more than the standard customer service.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 002: Valentine’s Day Love, Kendrick Lamar’s Super Bowl Performance, & NBA All-Star Weekend Highlights
programme.desc: In this exciting first episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, hosts Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive into all the hottest topics of the season! From the magic of Valentine’s Day love to Kendrick Lamar’s unforgettable Super Bowl halftime performance, this episode covers it all. Plus, get the inside scoop on the NBA All-Star Weekend, the biggest highlights, and what made it so memorable. Join us for a fun and lively conversation about music, sports, and everything in between!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 003: Nike Scandal, Lakers x One Piece Collab, and LA’s Strict Nightlife Rules & Discrimination
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith tackle some of the hottest topics in pop culture and beyond. First up: The mystery behind stolen Nikes—did Nike orchestrate the theft themselves? Then, they dive into the collaboration between the Lakers and One Piece, along with opening exclusive One Piece trading cards! The conversation heats up as they discuss the SAG Awards and the controversial nightlife rules and discrimination issues in big cities like LA. Tune in for an insightful, no-holds-barred discussion on current events and pop culture!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 004: Oscar Buzz, Pokémon Prismatic ETB Box Break, and the Mavericks' Downfall with Kyrie Irving
programme.desc: In this exciting episode of Mic'd: The Podcast Mic & Daniel dive into the latest buzz from the Oscars and what’s making headlines in Hollywood. But that’s not all—things get even more interesting when they break open a Pokémon Prismatic ETB box and explore the world of collectibles. The episode wraps up with a deep dive into the Mavericks’ recent struggles, including Kyrie Irving’s unexpected injury and what this means for the team’s future.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 005: Running the LA Marathon for Charity, Crypto Talk, NFL Trades & Japanese One Piece Cards
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon shares his personal journey as he prepares to run the LA Marathon this Sunday for charity. He talks about the motivation and drive required to commit to such a challenge and explains how anyone can push themselves to achieve big goals, no matter the obstacles. The conversation then shifts to the world of cryptocurrency, as Michelangelo and Daniel Smith break down the latest trends and discuss NFL trades. To cap off the episode, they open some rare Japanese One Piece trading cards.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 006: Adan Castillo on Training the Paul Brothers, Motivation & Pulling a Rare Pokémon Card
programme.desc: This week on Mic’d Up: The Podcast, we welcome a special guest—celebrity boxing coach Adan Castillo, the man behind Logan Paul’s training for The Mayweather Fight and Jake Paul’s transition into pro boxing. Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive deep into the world of elite training, discussing the mindset, motivation, and sacrifices it takes to succeed at the highest level. Beyond the ring, the conversation expands to the importance of inner circles, overcoming struggles, and the drive to chase your goals—whether you’re a celebrity or an everyday person striving for greatness. To top it off, the guys open Pokémon cards and pull the rarest card yet!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 007: Morning Routines That Trend, CONCACAF Nations League Soccer, & Jordan 4 Bricks Review
programme.desc: This week's episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast as Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith unpack the latest trends in morning routines that are sweeping the nation. Discover tips and tricks that might revolutionize your own start to the day. Switching gears, the hosts recap the excitement from the recent CONCACAF Nations League soccer games, discussing standout moments and key plays. Plus, don't miss their exclusive review of the sneaker of the year, the Jordan 4 "Bricks" by Nigel Sylvester.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 008: Avatar's Return, Nokia's Viral Video, Coachella Hype, NBA's Marketing Moves, NFL Rule Changes
programme.desc: Episode 008 of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith delve into the buzz surrounding the upcoming Avatar movie, discussing its potential impact and fan expectations. They analyze Nokia's latest music video that's taking the internet by storm and share their excitement for the approaching Coachella festival, highlighting anticipated performances and trends. The conversation shifts to the NBA, where they examine recent player suspensions and debate whether marketing strategies are influencing league decisions more than ever. They also unpack the NFL's new rule changes for 2025, exploring how adjustments to overtime and kickoff rules could affect game dynamics and betting landscapes . To top it all off, the hosts open a pack of Dragon Ball Z trading cards, aiming for those elusive God Rare cards, and discuss the thrill of collecting and the value of rare finds .

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 009: Coachella Special With The Girls! Festival Drama, Prismatic Evolutions & Dire Wolves Return?
programme.desc: Get festival-ready with this special Coachella episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast! Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith are joined by three special guests who reveal all the drama, stress, and secrets behind getting Coachella-ready. The excitement continues as they open a Pokémon Prismatic Evolutions box, letting the girls test their luck and pull some heat. Michelangelo also shares highlights from an unforgettable weekend with El Cristiano Tequila. Plus, they dive into the astonishing news of scientists bringing back an extinct species—the Dire Wolf. Don't miss this episode packed with festival tips, rare Pokémon cards, wild stories, and mind-blowing science news!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 010: Coachella Recap, WNBA Draft Highlights, Tariffs Shaking Fashion, True Religion Denim
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith recap Michelangelo’s unforgettable Coachella experience—covering standout performances, behind-the-scenes moments, and festival vibes. They dive into the highlights from the recent WNBA Draft and discuss the future of women's basketball. With tariffs impacting fashion and consumer products, the hosts explore what this means for your favorite brands and trends. Michelangelo showcases his fresh pair of True Religion jeans and shares his personal take on fashion’s latest moves. Plus, could dinosaurs really be making a comeback?

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 011: Sinners, Ryan Coogler's Huge Deal, Oscar Rule Changes, Shannon Sharpe’s Drama & NBA Playoffs!
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith break down the buzz around the upcoming movie Sinners, and dive into director Ryan Coogler’s groundbreaking deal that's changing the Hollywood landscape. They discuss the Oscars' new rules requiring voters to watch every nominated movie, potentially reshaping award season forever. The conversation heats up when addressing Shannon Sharpe’s lawsuit drama, exploring how legal situations differ between wealthy and not-so-wealthy relationships. In "Smitty’s Corner," Daniel tackles the latest highlights from the NBA Playoffs. Michelangelo also showcases El Cristiano Mezcal’s stunning bottle and introduces listeners to Disney's Labubus.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 012: 100 Men vs. Gorilla Debate, Stagecoach Stories, Sanders Draft Snub & Epic Pokémon Mewtwo Pull!
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith ignite the ultimate debate—can 100 men actually defeat one gorilla? The duo also dives into the buzz from Stagecoach Festival, unpacks the controversy surrounding Shedeur Sanders going undrafted, and discusses how ongoing tariffs are impacting businesses and consumers. Things get comedic when Daniel accidentally blocks Michelangelo’s face with a hookah mid-episode! Plus, the hosts open a rare Japanese Pokémon Team Rocket "Destined Rivals" booster box, and you won’t believe the incredible Mewtwo card they pull.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 013: Diageo's Fake Tequila Lawsuit, Cinco de Mayo Picks, Met Gala Madness & Grading Pokémon Slabs
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith uncork a wild discussion on the Diageo lawsuit over selling fake tequila—and what it means for the spirits industry. With Cinco de Mayo around the corner, they also shout out some of their favorite Mexican restaurants in Los Angeles and Ventura County you should definitely check out. In true fashion, they dive into the biggest moments and wildest outfits from this year’s Met Gala. During the “Tings I Buy” segment, Michelangelo shows off new Pokémon slab pickups and breaks down how to properly grade your cards. And of course, “Smitty’s Corner” gets heated with NBA Playoffs coverage. It’s tequila, tacos, fashion, slabs, and hoops
